generalAbilities.name: Fungus Sense
generalAbilities.description: A root rotter has imprecise tremorsense to detect the vibrations of creatures who are within a region of fungal terrain shared by the root rotter.

defensiveAbilities.name: Fungal Empowerment
defensiveAbilities.description: If the root rotter is touching fungal terrain at the start of its turn, they regain 10 Healing Damage Hit Points and are Quickened that turn; they can use the extra action only to Stride or Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Fungal Mind
defensiveAbilities.description: Root rotters communicate telepathically with each other. While within telepathic range of at least one other root rotter, they gain a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls, Perception checks, and saving throws against mental effects. If one root rotter is aware of a combatant, all members of the fungal mind within range are aware of it.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Disperse
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The root rotter has 25 Hit Points or fewer

Effect The root rotter destroys themself. Thorny fungal roots explode from their body, dealing 10d6 Piercing Damage damage in a 10ft Type:emanation (Basic DC 25 Reflex Saving Throw save). Any creature who fails the save is exposed to rotter infestation.

offensiveAbilities.name: Fungal Root
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The root rotter is standing in fungal terrain

Effect Fungal roots reach out to snag a nearby foe. An enemy within 30 feet of the root rotter takes 4d6 Piercing Damage damage and must attempt a DC 27 Reflex Saving Throw saving throw.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and becomes Clumsy 1 until the end of its next turn.

Failure The creature takes full damage and becomes clumsy 1 with an unlimited duration. In addition, the creature is Restrained (Escape dc=27) for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure but double damage. In addition, the creature is exposed to rotter infestation.

offensiveAbilities.name: Rotter Infestation
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 27 Fortitude Saving Throw

Onset 1 day

Stage 1 Drained 1 (1 day)

Stage 2 Drained 2 and can sense the presence of root rotters within 30 feet as an imprecise sense (1 round)

Stage 3 as stage 2, but transformation into a root rotter upon death (1 day)
